name: Disciple's Breath
text: You unleash your breath weapon without spending focus. This has the effects of your Dragon Breath sorcerer bloodline spell, though it deals 9d6 @actor.flags.system.dragonDisciple.energyType damage instead of its usual damage, and you don't have to cast it or spend a Focus Point. You can't use Disciple's Breath again for 1d4 rounds.
